**How to falsify it:** If genetic analysis reveals that variants in HMGCS2 are not associated with loss-of-function mutations in patients with 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA synthase deficiency, or if variants in ABCB4 do not lead to impaired bile salt transport or related lipid metabolism dysfunction in patients with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy, 3, this hypothesis would be falsified. _(variant: The presence of common variants (AF > 0.01) in the coding regions of HMGCS2 and ABCB4 in the general population, without a clear association with either disease phenotype, would weaken the hypothesis.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding this overlap could reveal shared therapeutic targets or strategies for managing lipid metabolism disorders. For instance, interventions aimed at restoring bile acid homeostasis or supporting cholesterol biosynthesis could potentially benefit patients with either condition, or related metabolic disorders.
